subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Coupler Curves: Hidden Geometry
description: A short lesson to help you apply Coupler Curves: Hidden Geometry.

hook.text: Pick a point on the floating coupler link and track where it goes.

buildup.text: That point traces a curve as the mechanism moves through its cycle.

discovery.text: Simple linkages can draw ovals, figure-eights, and even straight lines.

twist.text: Millions of possible curves exist just by moving the point on the coupler.

climax.text: Designers use coupler curves to create exact output paths for machines.

punchline.text: Four bars and a point can draw almost anything.

quiz.question: What is a coupler curve?
options: The speed profile of the driving crank
The path traced by a point on the floating coupler link during motion
The force curve of the mechanism under load
